verses.sloka: तत्र दिव्य उपमम् मुख्यम् स्फाटिकम् रत्न भूषितम् ।अवेक्षमाणो हनुमान् ददर्श शयन आसनम् ॥५-१०-१॥
verses.transliteration: tatra divya upamam mukhyam sphāṭikam ratna bhūṣitam ।avekṣamāṇo hanumān dadarśa śayana āsanam ॥5-10-1॥

translations.english: Looking around, Hanuman noticed a bed chamber, with a heavenly dais on which he saw a couch encrusted with crystals, vaidurya, and inlaid with colourful ivory and gold. It had an exquisite rich covering.
translations.hindi: सुन्दरकाण्ड का दसवां सगं पुरा हुआ । (* एकादशः संगः अवधूय च तां बुद्धि बभूवावस्थितस्तदा। जगाम चापरां चितां सीतां प्रति महाकपिः

verses.sloka: दान्तकाञ्चनिचित्राङ्गेर्वैश्च वरासनैः ।महार्हस्तरणोपेतैरुपपन्नम् महाधनैः ॥५-१०-२॥
verses.transliteration: dāntakāñcanicitrāṅgervaiśca varāsanaiḥ ।mahārhastaraṇopetairupapannam mahādhanaiḥ ॥5-10-2॥

translations.english: Looking around, Hanuman noticed a bed chamber, with a heavenly dais on which he saw a couch encrusted with crystals, vaidurya, and inlaid with colourful ivory and gold. It had an exquisite rich covering.
translations.hindi: बे मन ही मन कहने लगे कि, सीता पतिव्रता होकर श्रीराम के वियोग में न तो इस प्रकार सो ही सकती हें, न खा सकती हें, न श्रपना श्रृंगार कर सकती हं और न मदिरा ही पो सकती हें

verses.sloka: तस्य च एकतमे देशे सो अग्र्य माल्य विभूषितम् ।ददर्श पाण्डुरम् चत्रम् तारा अधिपति सम्निभम् ॥५-१०-३॥
verses.transliteration: tasya ca ekatame deśe so agrya mālya vibhūṣitam ।dadarśa pāṇḍuram catram tārā adhipati samnibham ॥5-10-3॥

translations.english: Hanuman saw an umbrella in one spot decorated with the best of garlands. The white umbrella looked like the Moon, lord of stars.
translations.hindi: सुन्दरकाण्डे झल्य पुरुष का तो पूछना ही वया, वह देवताओं के राजा इन्द्र को भीं पना पति नहीं समझ सकतीं । क्योंकि श्रीरामचन्द्रजी के सामने देवताशों में मी कोई नहीं है

verses.sloka: जातरूपपरिक्षिप्तम् चित्रभानुसमप्रभम् ।अशोकमालाविततम् ददर्श परमासनम् ॥५-१०-४॥
verses.transliteration: jātarūpaparikṣiptam citrabhānusamaprabham ।aśokamālāvitatam dadarśa paramāsanam ॥5-10-4॥

translations.english: He saw an exquisite couch made of gold shining wonderfully like the Sun. It was decorated with ashoka flowers. Women were holding fans of chamari deer. It was upholstered with the best of bedspreads made of soft sheep skin and adorned with beautiful strings of flower garlands. Scented with aromatic smoke, it was refreshed with fragrance which had spread all over the place.
translations.hindi: ग्रतः यह कोई और ही स्त्री है । इस प्रकार झपने मन में ठहरा, कपि- श्रेष्ठ हनुमानजी सीताजी के दर्शन की अभिलाषा किए हुए पुनः रावण की मदशाला में विचरने लगे । वहाँ उन्होंने देखा कि, कोई स्त्री खेल से, कोई गाने से और कोई नाचते-नाचते थक कर ग्रौर कोई नशे में चूर होकर आर मुरज अथवा मृदङ्ग का सहारा ले चोली कसे सो रही है

verses.sloka: वाल व्यजन हस्ताभिर् वीज्यमानम् समन्ततः ।गन्धैः च विविधैर् जुष्टम् वर धूपेन धूपितम् ॥५-१०-५॥
verses.transliteration: vāla vyajana hastābhir vījyamānam samantataḥ ।gandhaiḥ ca vividhair juṣṭam vara dhūpena dhūpitam ॥5-10-5॥

translations.english: He saw an exquisite couch made of gold shining wonderfully like the Sun. It was decorated with ashoka flowers. Women were holding fans of chamari deer. It was upholstered with the best of bedspreads made of soft sheep skin and adorned with beautiful strings of flower garlands. Scented with aromatic smoke, it was refreshed with fragrance which had spread all over the place.

verses.sloka: परम आस्तरण आस्तीर्णम् आविक अजिन सम्व्र्तम् ।दामभिर् वर माल्यानाम् समन्ताद् उपशोभितम् ॥५-१०-६॥
verses.transliteration: parama āstaraṇa āstīrṇam āvika ajina samvrtam ।dāmabhir vara mālyānām samantād upaśobhitam ॥5-10-6॥

translations.english: He saw an exquisite couch made of gold shining wonderfully like the Sun. It was decorated with ashoka flowers. Women were holding fans of chamari deer. It was upholstered with the best of bedspreads made of soft sheep skin and adorned with beautiful strings of flower garlands. Scented with aromatic smoke, it was refreshed with fragrance which had spread all over the place.
translations.hindi: ।॥ तथास्तरणमुख्येषु संदिष्टाश्चापराः स्त्रियः । अङ्गनानां सहस्रेण भूषितेन विभूषणः ६ ॥ कोई सुन्दर बिस्तरों पर यथा नियम पड़ सो रही थी । वहाँ पर हजारों स्त्रियाँ भूषणों से सजी सजाई पड़ी सो रही थीं

verses.sloka: तस्मिन् जीमूत सम्काशम् प्रदीप्त उत्तम कुण्डलम् ।लोहित अक्षम् महा बाहुम् महा रजत वाससम् ॥५-१०-७॥
verses.transliteration: tasmin jīmūta samkāśam pradīpta uttama kuṇḍalam ।lohita akṣam mahā bāhum mahā rajata vāsasam ॥5-10-7॥

translations.english: Hanuman saw the mightyarmed, heroic lord of demons, sleeping with huge bloodshot eyes looking like a cloud, he was adorned with flashing earrings, and clad in robes of silver texture. His body was smeared with red sandal paste of sweet fragrance. Therefore, he looked like a cloud reddened by twilight and flashing with the lightning of his ornaments. He was handsome and could assume any form at will. He looked like Mandara mountain surrounded thickly with trees and wild bushes. Decked with exquisite ornaments, he was sleeping after dalliance at night on that glittering couch. He was the beloved of the ogresses and bringer of joy to them
translations.hindi: हनुमानजी ने देखा कि उनमे से कोई स्त्री तो अपने रूप का बखान |! करने में कोई गान का भ्रथं समझा-समझा कर, कोई देशकालानुसार वार्तालाप करते-करते, कोई उचित बचन बोलते-बोलते ्रौर कोई रतिक्रीड़ा में रत हो, सोई हुई थी । उनके बीच में पड़ा सोता हुआ महाबाहु रावण ऐसा शोभाय- मान हो रहा था

verses.sloka: लोहितेन अनुलिप्त अन्गम् चन्दनेन सुगन्धिना ।सम्ध्या रक्तम् इव आकाशे तोयदम् सतडिद् गुणम् ॥५-१०-८॥
verses.transliteration: lohitena anulipta angam candanena sugandhinā ।samdhyā raktam iva ākāśe toyadam sataḍid guṇam ॥5-10-8॥

His body was smeared with red sandal paste of sweet fragrance. Therefore, he looked like a cloud reddened by twilight and flashing with the lightning of his ornaments. Decked with exquisite ornaments, he was sleeping after dalliance at night on that glittering couch. He was the beloved of the ogresses and bringer of joy to them

verses.sloka: वृतम् आभरणैर् दिव्यैः सुरूपम् काम रूपिणम् ।सव्र्क्ष वन गुल्म आढ्यम् प्रसुप्तम् इव मन्दरम् ॥५-१०-९॥
verses.transliteration: vṛtam ābharaṇair divyaiḥ surūpam kāma rūpiṇam ।savrkṣa vana gulma āḍhyam prasuptam iva mandaram ॥5-10-9॥

verses.sloka: क्रीडित्वा उपरतम् रात्रौ वर आभरण भूषितम् ।प्रियम् राक्षस कन्यानाम् राक्षसानाम् सुख आवहम् ॥५-१०-१०॥
verses.transliteration: krīḍitvā uparatam rātrau vara ābharaṇa bhūṣitam ।priyam rākṣasa kanyānām rākṣasānām sukha āvaham ॥5-10-10॥

translations.english: Hanuman saw the mightyarmed, heroic lord of demons, sleeping with huge bloodshot eyes looking like a cloud, he was adorned with flashing earrings, and clad in robes of silver texture. His body was smeared with red sandal paste of sweet fragrance. Therefore, he looked like a cloud reddened by twilight and flashing with the lightning of his ornaments. He was handsome and could assume any form at will. He looked like Mandara mountain surrounded thickly with trees and wild bushes. Decked with exquisite ornaments, he was sleeping after dalliance at night on that glittering couch. He was the beloved of the ogresses and bringer of joy to them
translations.hindi: ॥ गोष्ठे महति मुख्यागां गवां मध्ये यथा वृषः । स राक्षसेन्द्रः शुशुभे ताभिः परिवृतः स्वयम्‌ ॥ & ॥ जैसे किसी बड़ी गोठ में, गौगों के बीच साँड़ शोभायमान होता है उसी प्रकार स्वयं राक्षसेन्द्र रावण उन स्त्रियों. के बीच शोभायमान हो रहा: था ॥॥ €॥। करेणुभिर्यथारण्ये परिकीर्णो महाद्विपः । सर्वेकामेरुपेतां च पानभूमि महात्मनः

verses.sloka: पीत्वा अपि उपरतम् च अपि ददर्श स महा कपिः ।भास्करे शयने वीरम् प्रसुप्तम् राक्षस अधिपम् ॥५-१०-११॥
verses.transliteration: pītvā api uparatam ca api dadarśa sa mahā kapiḥ ।bhāskare śayane vīram prasuptam rākṣasa adhipam ॥5-10-11॥

translations.english: Hanuman saw the mightyarmed, heroic lord of demons, sleeping with huge bloodshot eyes looking like a cloud, he was adorned with flashing earrings, and clad in robes of silver texture. His body was smeared with red sandal paste of sweet fragrance. Therefore, he looked like a cloud reddened by twilight and flashing with the lightning of his ornaments. He was handsome and could assume any form at will. He looked like Mandara mountain surrounded thickly with trees and wild bushes. Decked with exquisite ornaments, he was sleeping after dalliance at night on that glittering couch. He was the beloved of the ogresses and bringer of joy to them
translations.hindi: कषिश्चेष्ठ हनुमानजी ने, रावण की उस पानशाला में हिरनों का, भैंसों का और शूकरो का मांस, श्रलग-श्रलग रखा हुआ देखा

verses.sloka: निह्श्वसन्तम् यथा नागम् रावणम् वानर उत्तमः ।आसाद्य परम उद्विग्नः सो अपासर्पत् सुभीतवत् ॥५-१०-१२॥
verses.transliteration: nihśvasantam yathā nāgam rāvaṇam vānara uttamaḥ ।āsādya parama udvignaḥ so apāsarpat subhītavat ॥5-10-12॥

translations.english: Having reached Ravana, who was breathing (hissing) like a snake, Hanuman was for a moment frightened and drew away from him as if he was put to terrible fear.
translations.hindi: हनुमानजी ने उस पानशाला में सोने के पात्रों में रखे हुए श्रौर प्रघखाए- हुए, मुरगों भ्रौर मोरों के मांस देखे । शूकर, जंगली बकरा ( जिसके लम्बे कान होते हैं ) सेही, हिरनों श्रौर मोरों के मांस, वहाँ दही श्रौर नमक सेः लपेटे हुए हनुमानजी ने देखे । विविध प्रकार से बनाये हुए तीतरों और चकोरों के मांस श्रघखाए हुए वहाँ देख पड़े

verses.sloka: अथ आरोहणम् आसाद्य वेदिका अन्तरम् आश्रितः ।सुप्तम् राक्षस शार्दूलम् प्रेक्षते स्म महा कपिः ॥५-१०-१३॥
verses.transliteration: atha ārohaṇam āsādya vedikā antaram āśritaḥ ।suptam rākṣasa śārdūlam prekṣate sma mahā kapiḥ ॥5-10-13॥

translations.english: The great vanara ascended the stairway and reached another altar and once again looked at the sleeping Ravana, the tiger among demons.

verses.sloka: शुशुभे राक्षस इन्द्रस्य स्वपतः शयन उत्तमम् ।गन्ध हस्तिनि सम्विष्टे यथा प्रस्रवणम् महत् ॥५-१०-१४॥
verses.transliteration: śuśubhe rākṣasa indrasya svapataḥ śayana uttamam ।gandha hastini samviṣṭe yathā prasravaṇam mahat ॥5-10-14॥

translations.english: While the lord of demons lay asleep on the magnificent couch, he looked like the Prasravana hill with its elephant in rut.

verses.sloka: कान्चन अन्गद नद्धौ च ददर्श स महात्मनः ।विक्षिप्तौ राक्षस इन्द्रस्य भुजाव् इन्द्र ध्वज उपमौ ॥५-१०-१५॥
verses.transliteration: kāncana angada naddhau ca dadarśa sa mahātmanaḥ ।vikṣiptau rākṣasa indrasya bhujāv indra dhvaja upamau ॥5-10-15॥

translations.english: Hanuman saw the great Ravana's arms, which were like a pair of Indra's flag staff adorned with golden straps. The arms bore the marks of wounds caused by Airavata, (Indra's elephant), torn by the thunderbolt of Indra in war, and wounded by the discus of Lord Visnu. His strong, fleshy, wellbuilt arms, having auspicious thumbnails, shapely fingers and palms, pressed together, resembled the iron crowbars or beam used for main doors. The arms resembled elephant's trunks, tossed on a clean bed, resembling two fivehooded snakes (fingers like hoods), besmeared with cool, fragrant, red sandalpaste of excellent quality which looked red like the hare's blood. They were well massaged by the best of women with fine, fragrant sandal paste. They were the arms which could make yakshas, pannagas, gods and demons roar in fear at their sight.
translations.hindi: भेंसों, एकशल्य मत्स्यो, ( मछली जिसके एक काँटा होता है) ओर बकरों के भली भाँति पकाये हुए मांस वहाँ रखे थे । इनके अतिरिक्त अन्य विविध प्रकार के चाटने, खाने ओर पीने के पदार्थ भी वहाँ रखे थे

verses.sloka: ऐरावत विषाण अग्रैर् आपीडित क्र्त व्रणौ ।वज्र उल्लिखित पीन अम्सौ विष्णु चक्र परिक्षितौ ॥५-१०-१६॥
verses.transliteration: airāvata viṣāṇa agrair āpīḍita krta vraṇau ।vajra ullikhita pīna amsau viṣṇu cakra parikṣitau ॥5-10-16॥

They were well massaged by the best of women with fine, fragrant sandal paste. They were the arms which could make yakshas, pannagas, gods and demons roar in fear at their sight.
translations.hindi: इनमें बहुत से तो चरपरे, खट्टे और नमकीन पदार्थों से मिश्रित थे । फिर सफेद सरसों के बनाये हुए षड्रस पदार्थ भी थे । किसी किसी पीने के पात्र में बहुमूल्य हार, नूपुर ग्रौर विजायठ पडे हुए थे

verses.sloka: पीनौ समसुजात अम्सौ सम्गतौ बल सम्युतौ ।सुलक्षण नख अन्गुष्ठौ स्वन्गुली तल लक्षितौ ॥५-१०-१७॥
verses.transliteration: pīnau samasujāta amsau samgatau bala samyutau ।sulakṣaṇa nakha anguṣṭhau svangulī tala lakṣitau ॥5-10-17॥

verses.sloka: सम्हतौ परिघ आकारौ व्र्त्तौ करि कर उपमौ ।विक्षिप्तौ शयने शुभ्रे पन्च शीर्षाव् इव उरगौ ॥५-१०-१८॥
verses.transliteration: samhatau parigha ākārau vrttau kari kara upamau ।vikṣiptau śayane śubhre panca śīrṣāv iva uragau ॥5-10-18॥

The arms resembled elephant's trunks, tossed on a clean bed, resembling two fivehooded snakes (fingers like hoods), besmeared with cool, fragrant, red sandalpaste of excellent quality which looked red like the hare's blood. They were well massaged by the best of women with fine, fragrant sandal paste. They were the arms which could make yakshas, pannagas, gods and demons roar in fear at their sight.

verses.sloka: शश क्षतज कल्पेन सुशीतेन सुगन्धिना ।चन्दनेन पर अर्ध्येन स्वनुलिप्तौ स्वलम्क्र्तौ ॥५-१०-१९॥
verses.transliteration: śaśa kṣataja kalpena suśītena sugandhinā ।candanena para ardhyena svanuliptau svalamkrtau ॥5-10-19॥

translations.english: Hanuman saw the great Ravana's arms, which were like a pair of Indra's flag staff adorned with golden straps. The arms bore the marks of wounds caused by Airavata, (Indra's elephant), torn by the thunderbolt of Indra in war, and wounded by the discus of Lord Visnu. His strong, fleshy, wellbuilt arms, having auspicious thumbnails, shapely fingers and palms, pressed together, resembled the iron crowbars or beam used for main doors. The arms resembled elephant's trunks, tossed on a clean bed, resembling two fivehooded snakes (fingers like hoods), besmeared with cool, fragrant, red sandalpaste of excellent quality which looked red like the hare's blood. They were well massaged by the best of women with fine, fragrant sandal paste. They were the arms which could make yakshas, pannagas, gods and demons roar in fear at their sight.

verses.sloka: उत्तम स्त्री विम्र्दितौ गन्ध उत्तम निषेवितौ ।यक्ष पन्नग गन्धर्व देव दानव राविणौ ॥५-१०-२०॥
verses.transliteration: uttama strī vimrditau gandha uttama niṣevitau ।yakṣa pannaga gandharva deva dānava rāviṇau ॥5-10-20॥

translations.english: Hanuman saw the great Ravana's arms, which were like a pair of Indra's flag staff adorned with golden straps. The arms bore the marks of wounds caused by Airavata, (Indra's elephant), torn by the thunderbolt of Indra in war, and wounded by the discus of Lord Visnu. His strong, fleshy, wellbuilt arms, having auspicious thumbnails, shapely fingers and palms, pressed together, resembled the iron crowbars or beam used for main doors. The arms resembled elephant's trunks, tossed on a clean bed, resembling two fivehooded snakes (fingers like hoods), besmeared with cool, fragrant, red sandalpaste of excellent quality which looked red like the hare's blood. They were well massaged by the best of women with fine, fragrant sandal paste. They were the arms which could make yakshas, pannagas, gods and demons roar in fear at their sight.
translations.hindi: मांसों के अतिरिक्त वारुणी जाति की मदिरा तथा श्रन्य विविध प्रकार की साफ और बनावटी शराबे भी वहाँ थी । चीनी की, शहद की, फूलों [ महुआ आदि के फूलों से खींची हुई] की ग्रीर फलों से सींची हुईं शराबें भी वहाँ रखी हुईं थीं

verses.sloka: ददर्श स कपिः तस्य बाहू शयन सम्स्थितौ ।मन्दरस्य अन्तरे सुप्तौ महा अर्ही रुषिताव् इव ॥५-१०-२१॥
verses.transliteration: dadarśa sa kapiḥ tasya bāhū śayana samsthitau ।mandarasya antare suptau mahā arhī ruṣitāv iva ॥5-10-21॥

translations.english: The vanara, gazed at the arms of Ravana placed on the couch that appeared like two angry snakes asleep in a cave on (the lap) of mount Mandara.
translations.hindi: अनेक प्रकार के साफ किए हुए सुगन्धित मसालो से बसाए हुए मांस और मदिराएँ वहाँ प्रलग श्रलग रखी थीं। वह पानशाला फूलों के ढेरों से, सुवर्ण कलसों से, स्फटिक के पात्रों से और सोने के गेडुओं से परिपूर्ण थी

verses.sloka: ताभ्याम् स परिपूर्णाभ्याम् भुजाभ्याम् राक्षस अधिपः ।शुशुभे अचल सम्काशः श्र्न्गाभ्याम् इव मन्दरः ॥५-१०-२२॥
verses.transliteration: tābhyām sa paripūrṇābhyām bhujābhyām rākṣasa adhipaḥ ।śuśubhe acala samkāśaḥ śrngābhyām iva mandaraḥ ॥5-10-22॥

translations.english: The lord of demons looked splendid like a mountain with his long, fully developed arms. He appeared like Mandara mountain with two lofty peaks.

verses.sloka: चूत पुम्नाग सुरभिर् बकुल उत्तम सम्युतः ।मृष्ट अन्न रस सम्युक्तः पान गन्ध पुरः सरः ॥५-१०-२३॥
verses.transliteration: cūta pumnāga surabhir bakula uttama samyutaḥ ।mṛṣṭa anna rasa samyuktaḥ pāna gandha puraḥ saraḥ ॥5-10-23॥

translations.english: The breath released from the huge mouth of that lion of demons carried the fragrance of mango and punnaga as well as excellent Bakula flowers. It exuded the aroma of rich and delicious food and different drink. It was as though pervading the whole chamber.
translations.hindi: हनुमानजी ने देखा कि कहीं चाँदी के श्रौर कहीं सोने के बड़े बड़े पात्रों में भ्रच्छी श्रच्छी शराब भरी हुई हैं

verses.sloka: तस्य राक्षस सिम्हस्य निश्चक्राम मुखान् महान् ।शयानस्य विनिह्श्वासः पूरयन्न् इव तद् ग्र्हम् ॥५-१०-२४॥
verses.transliteration: tasya rākṣasa simhasya niścakrāma mukhān mahān ।śayānasya vinihśvāsaḥ pūrayann iva tad grham ॥5-10-24॥

translations.english: The breath released from the huge mouth of that lion of demons carried the fragrance of mango and punnaga as well as excellent Bakula flowers. It exuded the aroma of rich and delicious food and different drink. It was as though pervading the whole chamber.
translations.hindi: हनुमानजी ने और भी देखा कि सुवर्ण, मणि और चाँदी के पात्रों में मदिराएं भरी हुई हँ

verses.sloka: मुक्ता मणि विचित्रेण कान्चनेन विराजता ।मुकुटेन अपव्र्त्तेन कुण्डल उज्ज्वलित आननम् ॥५-१०-२५॥
verses.transliteration: muktā maṇi vicitreṇa kāncanena virājatā ।mukuṭena apavrttena kuṇḍala ujjvalita ānanam ॥5-10-25॥

translations.english: Hanuman saw Ravana, whose face was lit up by his earrings. His shining headgear studded with gold and pearls was set aside. His fleshy, broad chest on which the pearl necklace had slightly receded from its position(as he was asleep) was shining along with the red sandal paste. He had put on a splendid white silken cloth which had also slipped a little and was covered with exquisitely rich yellow upper garment. His eyes were bloodred. His body was comparable to a heap of blackbeans. He was sighing heavily like a hissing snake. He appeared like an elephant sleeping on the banks of the great river Ganges. With four golden lamps glowing on four sides of the bed,the four directions were illuminated. All his limbs lit up bright (with the glow of lamps), he looked like a cloud with streaks of lightning. His dear wives were seen resting at his feet in the palace of the lord of demons.
translations.hindi: हनुमानजी ने देखा कि, उन पात्रों में कोई तो भ्राधे खाली थे, कोई बिल्कुल खाली थे ओर कोई ज्यों के त्यों लबालब भरे हुए थे

verses.sloka: रक्त चन्दन दिग्धेन तथा हारेण शोभिता ।पीन आयत विशालेन वक्षसा अभिविराजितम् ॥५-१०-२६॥
verses.transliteration: rakta candana digdhena tathā hāreṇa śobhitā ।pīna āyata viśālena vakṣasā abhivirājitam ॥5-10-26॥

translations.english: Hanuman saw Ravana, whose face was lit up by his earrings. His shining headgear studded with gold and pearls was set aside. His fleshy, broad chest on which the pearl necklace had slightly receded from its position(as he was asleep) was shining along with the red sandal paste. He had put on a splendid white silken cloth which had also slipped a little and was covered with exquisitely rich yellow upper garment. His eyes were bloodred. His body was comparable to a heap of blackbeans. He was sighing heavily like a hissing snake. He appeared like an elephant sleeping on the banks of the great river Ganges. With four golden lamps glowing on four sides of the bed,the four directions were illuminated. All his limbs lit up bright (with the glow of lamps), he looked like a cloud with streaks of lightning. His dear wives were seen resting at his feet in the palace of the lord of demons.
translations.hindi: किसी स्थान में विविध प्रकार की भोजन-सामग्री और पीने योग्य मदिरा सजा कर रखी हुई थी । कहीं पर भक्ष्य पदार्थ आाधे खाए हुए पड़े थे । इन सब वस्तुओं को देखते भालते हनुमानजी वहाँ विचर रहे थे

verses.sloka: पाण्डुरेण अपविद्धेन क्षौमेण क्षतज ईक्षणम् ।महा अर्हेण सुसम्वीतम् पीतेन उत्तम वाससा ॥५-१०-२७॥
verses.transliteration: pāṇḍureṇa apaviddhena kṣaumeṇa kṣataja īkṣaṇam ।mahā arheṇa susamvītam pītena uttama vāsasā ॥5-10-27॥

translations.english: Hanuman saw Ravana, whose face was lit up by his earrings. His shining headgear studded with gold and pearls was set aside. His fleshy, broad chest on which the pearl necklace had slightly receded from its position(as he was asleep) was shining along with the red sandal paste. He had put on a splendid white silken cloth which had also slipped a little and was covered with exquisitely rich yellow upper garment. His eyes were bloodred. His body was comparable to a heap of blackbeans. He was sighing heavily like a hissing snake. He appeared like an elephant sleeping on the banks of the great river Ganges. With four golden lamps glowing on four sides of the bed,the four directions were illuminated. All his limbs lit up bright (with the glow of lamps), he looked like a cloud with streaks of lightning. His dear wives were seen resting at his feet in the palace of the lord of demons.
translations.hindi: कहीं पर टूटे गडुवें श्रोर कहीं पर खाली घड़े लुढ़क रहे थे। कहीं पर फूलों की मालाग्रों, मूलों और फलों का गडमगड्ड हो रहा था

verses.sloka: माष राशि प्रतीकाशम् निह्श्वसन्तम् भुजन्गवत् ।गान्गे महति तोय अन्ते प्रसुतमिव कुन्जरम् ॥५-१०-२८॥
verses.transliteration: māṣa rāśi pratīkāśam nihśvasantam bhujangavat ।gānge mahati toya ante prasutamiva kunjaram ॥5-10-28॥

translations.english: Hanuman saw Ravana, whose face was lit up by his earrings. His shining headgear studded with gold and pearls was set aside. His fleshy, broad chest on which the pearl necklace had slightly receded from its position(as he was asleep) was shining along with the red sandal paste. He had put on a splendid white silken cloth which had also slipped a little and was covered with exquisitely rich yellow upper garment. His eyes were bloodred. His body was comparable to a heap of blackbeans. He was sighing heavily like a hissing snake. He appeared like an elephant sleeping on the banks of the great river Ganges. With four golden lamps glowing on four sides of the bed,the four directions were illuminated. All his limbs lit up bright (with the glow of lamps), he looked like a cloud with streaks of lightning. His dear wives were seen resting at his feet in the palace of the lord of demons.
translations.hindi: कहीं कहीं स्त्रियों की सेजें सूनी पड़ी थीं और कोई कोई स्त्रयां ध्लापस में पलिपटी हुई सो रही थीं

verses.sloka: चतुर्भिः कान्चनैर् दीपैर् दीप्यमानैः चतुर् दिशम् ।प्रकाशी क्र्त सर्व अन्गम् मेघम् विद्युद् गणैर् इव ॥५-१०-२९॥
verses.transliteration: caturbhiḥ kāncanair dīpair dīpyamānaiḥ catur diśam ।prakāśī krta sarva angam megham vidyud gaṇair iva ॥5-10-29॥

translations.english: Hanuman saw Ravana, whose face was lit up by his earrings. His shining headgear studded with gold and pearls was set aside. His fleshy, broad chest on which the pearl necklace had slightly receded from its position(as he was asleep) was shining along with the red sandal paste. He had put on a splendid white silken cloth which had also slipped a little and was covered with exquisitely rich yellow upper garment. His eyes were bloodred. His body was comparable to a heap of blackbeans. He was sighing heavily like a hissing snake. He appeared like an elephant sleeping on the banks of the great river Ganges. With four golden lamps glowing on four sides of the bed,the four directions were illuminated. All his limbs lit up bright (with the glow of lamps), he looked like a cloud with streaks of lightning. His dear wives were seen resting at his feet in the palace of the lord of demons.

verses.sloka: पाद मूल गताः च अपि ददर्श सुमहात्मनः ।पत्नीः स प्रिय भार्यस्य तस्य रक्षः पतेर् ग्र्हे ॥५-१०-३०॥
verses.transliteration: pāda mūla gatāḥ ca api dadarśa sumahātmanaḥ ।patnīḥ sa priya bhāryasya tasya rakṣaḥ pater grhe ॥5-10-30॥

translations.english: Hanuman saw Ravana, whose face was lit up by his earrings. His shining headgear studded with gold and pearls was set aside. His fleshy, broad chest on which the pearl necklace had slightly receded from its position(as he was asleep) was shining along with the red sandal paste. He had put on a splendid white silken cloth which had also slipped a little and was covered with exquisitely rich yellow upper garment. His eyes were bloodred. His body was comparable to a heap of blackbeans. He was sighing heavily like a hissing snake. He appeared like an elephant sleeping on the banks of the great river Ganges. With four golden lamps glowing on four sides of the bed,the four directions were illuminated. All his limbs lit up bright (with the glow of lamps), he looked like a cloud with streaks of lightning. His dear wives were seen resting at his feet in the palace of the lord of demons.

verses.sloka: शशि प्रकाश वदना वर कुण्डल भूषिताः ।अम्बाल माल्य आभरणा ददर्श हरि यूथपः ॥५-१०-३१॥
verses.transliteration: śaśi prakāśa vadanā vara kuṇḍala bhūṣitāḥ ।ambāla mālya ābharaṇā dadarśa hari yūthapaḥ ॥5-10-31॥

translations.english: Hanuman, the leader of vanaras found the wives of Ravana, whose faces were bright as the Moon, adorned with beautiful earrings and fresh floral garlands.
translations.hindi: शीतल चन्दन, मदिरा, मधुररस, विविध प्रकार की मालाएँ प्रौर विविध अकार की धूपों का गन्ध लिए पवन बह रहा था । अनेक प्रकार के चन्दनों के इत्रों की ग्रौर सुगन्धित पदार्थो की बनी घूपों की सुगन्धि उड़ाता हुभ्रा पवन उस समय पुष्पकविमान में व्याप्त (भरा हुश्रा) हो रहा था । हनुमानजी ने रावण के रनवास में श्रनेक स्त्रियां देखीं, जिनमें कोई साँवली भ्रौर कोई "वणवण की थी। वे सब रति से थक कर सो रही थीं

verses.sloka: नृत्त वादित्र कुशला राक्षस इन्द्र भुज अन्कगाः ।वर आभरण धारिण्यो निषन्ना दद्र्शे कपिः ॥५-१०-३२॥
verses.transliteration: nṛtta vāditra kuśalā rākṣasa indra bhuja ankagāḥ ।vara ābharaṇa dhāriṇyo niṣannā dadrśe kapiḥ ॥5-10-32॥

translations.english: Hanuman saw the women there wearing fine jewellery, performing dances, playing musical instruments, and resting on the lap or leaning on the arms of the demon king.

verses.sloka: वज्र वैदूर्य गर्भाणि श्रवण अन्तेषु योषिताम् ।ददर्श तापनीयानि कुण्डलानि अन्गदानि च ॥५-१०-३३॥
verses.transliteration: vajra vaidūrya garbhāṇi śravaṇa anteṣu yoṣitām ।dadarśa tāpanīyāni kuṇḍalāni angadāni ca ॥5-10-33॥

translations.english: He noticed on the earlobes of the the women gold earrings decked with diamonds and vaidurya. They were wearing shining armlets of gold.

verses.sloka: तासाम् चन्द्र उपमैर् वक्त्रैः शुभैर् ललित कुण्डलैः ।विरराज विमानम् तन् नभः तारा गणैर् इव ॥५-१०-३४॥
verses.transliteration: tāsām candra upamair vaktraiḥ śubhair lalita kuṇḍalaiḥ ।virarāja vimānam tan nabhaḥ tārā gaṇair iva ॥5-10-34॥

translations.english: There the beautiful moonlike faces of women Illumined by the lovely earrings lay on the cot which looked resplendent like the sky lit up with hosts of stars.

verses.sloka: मद व्यायाम खिन्नाः ताः राक्षस इन्द्रस्य योषितः ।तेषु तेष्व् अवकाशेषु प्रसुप्ताः तनु मध्यमाः ॥५-१०-३५॥
verses.transliteration: mada vyāyāma khinnāḥ tāḥ rākṣasa indrasya yoṣitaḥ ।teṣu teṣv avakāśeṣu prasuptāḥ tanu madhyamāḥ ॥5-10-35॥

translations.english: Exhausted by drinking and indulging in amorous sport, the consorts of Ravana slept here and there with their visible slender waists.
translations.hindi: उस रात में उनका सौन्दर्य मुरझाई हुई कमलिनी की तरह हो रहा था। इस प्रकार रावण के रनवास में हनुमानजी ने सब कुछ देखा

verses.sloka: अङ्गहारैस्तथैवान्या कोवलैर्नृत्तशालिनी ।विन्यस्तशुभसर्वाङ्गी प्रसुप्ता वरवर्णिनी ॥५-१०-३६॥
verses.transliteration: aṅgahāraistathaivānyā kovalairnṛttaśālinī ।vinyastaśubhasarvāṅgī prasuptā varavarṇinī ॥5-10-36॥

translations.english: Another woman exceedingly beautiful and a delicate danseuse of beautiful complexion and rhythmic movements held her limbs in a dancing posture (though asleep) due to her habit .

verses.sloka: काचिद् वीणाम् परिष्वज्य प्रसुप्ता सम्प्रकाशते ।महा नदी प्रकीर्णा इव नलिनी पोतम् आश्रिता ॥५-१०-३७॥
verses.transliteration: kācid vīṇām pariṣvajya prasuptā samprakāśate ।mahā nadī prakīrṇā iva nalinī potam āśritā ॥5-10-37॥

translations.english: Another woman slept hugging her veena. She shone like a lotus plant flung in a large river, clinging on to a boat. (Veena is compared to a boat and the woman to a lotusplant in the ambience of flowing waters of the river. The entire hall had put up such a dynamic view showing hectic life of the inmates).
translations.hindi: बहुत चिन्तित हुए, क्योंकि सोती हुई परस्त्रियो को देखने से उनको श्रपने धर्म के नष्ट होने की शंका उत्पन्न हो गई

verses.sloka: अन्या कक्ष गतेन एव मड्डुकेन असित ईक्षणा ।प्रसुप्ता भामिनी भाति बाल पुत्रा इव वत्सला ॥५-१०-३८॥
verses.transliteration: anyā kakṣa gatena eva maḍḍukena asita īkṣaṇā ।prasuptā bhāminī bhāti bāla putrā iva vatsalā ॥5-10-38॥

translations.english: A woman with dark eyes asleep with a drum placed in her armpit looked like a beautiful mother holding her loving baby (the drum was hung to her arm with a rope).
translations.hindi: बे मन ही मन कहने लगे कि ] मेरा यह कर्म [ सोती हुई पराई स्त्रियों का देखना ] अवश्य मेरे धर्मजनित पुण्य को नष्ट कर देगा आ्राजतक मैने बरी दृष्टि से स्त्रियों को कभी नहीं देखा

verses.sloka: पटहम् चारु सर्व अन्गी पीड्य शेते शुभ स्तनी ।चिरस्य रमणम् लब्ध्वा परिष्वज्य इव कामिनी ॥५-१०-३९॥
verses.transliteration: paṭaham cāru sarva angī pīḍya śete śubha stanī ।cirasya ramaṇam labdhvā pariṣvajya iva kāminī ॥5-10-39॥

translations.english: Another charming beauty endowed with beautiful breasts lay hugging a tambourine as though a passionate woman lay embracing her lover whom she secured after a long time.
translations.hindi: किन्तु आज मैंने परस्त्रीगामी रावण को देखा है । इस प्रकार चिन्ता करते करते मनस्वी हनुमानजी के मन में, एक दूसरी बात उत्पन्न | हुई

verses.sloka: काचिद् अम्शम् परिष्वज्य सुप्ता कमल लोचना ।रहः प्रियतमम् गृह्य सकामेव च कामिनी ॥५-१०-४०॥
verses.transliteration: kācid amśam pariṣvajya suptā kamala locanā ।rahaḥ priyatamam gṛhya sakāmeva ca kāminī ॥5-10-40॥

translations.english: Yet another lotuseyed lady slept embracing a lute as if a lovelorn woman lay clasping her lover.
translations.hindi: उनके मन में स्थिरता भ्रोर निश्चयपूर्वक यह बात झाई कि, यर्या मेंने इन स्त्रियों को देखा, तथापि मेरे मन में उत्प! (०-0. Nanalji Deshmukh Library, BJP, नुमे तिल्‌ भर भी | विकार नहीं हुआ । फिर मन ही तो पाप और पुण्य करने वाली सब इन्द्रियों का प्रेरक है । सो वह मन मेरे वश में है । प्रत: मुझे सोती हुई पराई स्त्रियों के देखने का पाप नहीं लग सकता । फिर अन्यत्र में सीता को ढूंढ भी तो कहाँ सकता था

verses.sloka: विपञ्चैइम् परिगृह्यान्या नियता नृत्तशालिनी ।निद्रा वशम् अनुप्राप्ता सह कान्ता इव भामिनी ॥५-१०-४१॥
verses.transliteration: vipañcaiim parigṛhyānyā niyatā nṛttaśālinī ।nidrā vaśam anuprāptā saha kāntā iva bhāminī ॥5-10-41॥

translations.english: Another selfpossessed lady, graceful in dance, holding a sevenstringed lute was as though lying asleep with her beloved.

verses.sloka: अन्या कनक सम्काशैर् म्र्दु पीनैर् मनो रमैः ।मृदन्गम् परिपीड्य अन्गैः प्रसुप्ता मत्त लोचना ॥५-१०-४२॥
verses.transliteration: anyā kanaka samkāśair mrdu pīnair mano ramaiḥ ।mṛdangam paripīḍya angaiḥ prasuptā matta locanā ॥5-10-42॥

translations.english: Another lady with drunken eyes lay fast asleep holding a drum close to her beautiful bosom with her soft limbs. (These images show that these women were singing and dancing till late night and slept exhausted).

verses.sloka: भुज पार्श्व अन्तरस्थेन कक्षगेन क्र्श उदरी ।पणवेन सह अनिन्द्या सुप्ता मद क्र्त श्रमा ॥५-१०-४३॥
verses.transliteration: bhuja pārśva antarasthena kakṣagena krśa udarī ।paṇavena saha anindyā suptā mada krta śramā ॥5-10-43॥

translations.english: Another lady of slender belly, who had been exhausted by drunkeness was lying with a tabor pressed to her bosom and inserted in her armpit.
translations.hindi: स्त्रियाँ तो स्त्रियों ही में दढ़ी जाती हूँ! जिस प्राणी की जो जाति होती है, वह प्राणी उसी जाति में खोजा जाता है

verses.sloka: डिण्डिमम् परिग्र्ह्य अन्या तथैव आसक्त डिण्डिमा ।प्रसुप्ता तरुणम् वत्सम् उपगूह्य इव भामिनी ॥५-१०-४४॥
verses.transliteration: ḍiṇḍimam parigrhya anyā tathaiva āsakta ḍiṇḍimā ।prasuptā taruṇam vatsam upagūhya iva bhāminī ॥5-10-44॥

translations.english: One lovely woman and another held a drum and slept as if they were hugging their young child.
translations.hindi: खोई हुई स्त्री हिरनियों के समूह में नहीं खोजी जाती । श्रत: मैने शुद्ध मन से जानकी को खोजते हुए

verses.sloka: काचिद् आडम्बरम् नारी भुज सम्भोग पीडितम् ।कृत्वा कमल पत्र अक्षी प्रसुप्ता मद मोहिता ॥५-१०-४५॥
verses.transliteration: kācid āḍambaram nārī bhuja sambhoga pīḍitam ।kṛtvā kamala patra akṣī prasuptā mada mohitā ॥5-10-45॥

translations.english: Yet another with her eyes like lotus petals deluded with passion tightly held in her arms a musical instrument known as Adambaram and slept.
translations.hindi: रावण के समर; ग्रन्तःपुर को ढूढ़ा, पर जानकीजी न देख पड़ीं । वीर्यवान हनुमान ने वहाँ देव, गन्धर्वं ग्रौर नागों की कन्याग्रों को तो देखा किन्तु उनको जानकी न देक्ष पड़ीं । तब हनुमानजी ने जानकी को न देख कर, श्रन्य सुन्दरी स्त्रियों में जानकीजी को तलाश किया

verses.sloka: कलशीम् अपविद्ध्य अन्या प्रसुप्ता भाति भामिनी ।वसन्ते पुष्प शबला माला इव परिमार्जिता ॥५-१०-४६॥
verses.transliteration: kalaśīm apaviddhya anyā prasuptā bhāti bhāminī ।vasante puṣpa śabalā mālā iva parimārjitā ॥5-10-46॥

translations.english: Another lovely lady was fast asleep, having turned a goblet of water aside, yet another lay like a garland of variegated flowers in spring season.

verses.sloka: पाणिभ्याम् च कुचौ काचित् सुवर्ण कलश उपमौ ।उपगूह्य अबला सुप्ता निद्रा बल पराजिता ॥५-१०-४७॥
verses.transliteration: pāṇibhyām ca kucau kācit suvarṇa kalaśa upamau ।upagūhya abalā suptā nidrā bala parājitā ॥5-10-47॥

translations.english: Overcome with sleep another woman lay pressing with her own hands her golden gobletlike breasts.

verses.sloka: अन्या कमल पत्र अक्षी पूर्ण इन्दु सद्र्श आनना ।अन्याम् आलिन्ग्य सुश्रोणी प्रसुप्ता मद विह्वला ॥५-१०-४८॥
verses.transliteration: anyā kamala patra akṣī pūrṇa indu sadrśa ānanā ।anyām ālingya suśroṇī prasuptā mada vihvalā ॥5-10-48॥

translations.english: One woman with eyes like lotus petals and face like the fullmoon embraced another young woman of beautiful hips and slept tipsy with drink.

verses.sloka: आतोद्यानि विचित्राणि परिष्वज्य वर स्त्रियः ।निपीड्य च कुचैः सुप्ताः कामिन्यः कामुकान् इव ॥५-१०-४९॥
verses.transliteration: ātodyāni vicitrāṇi pariṣvajya vara striyaḥ ।nipīḍya ca kucaiḥ suptāḥ kāminyaḥ kāmukān iva ॥5-10-49॥

translations.english: Some charming maidens held wonderful musical instruments pressing against their bosom and slept like passionate women embracing their loved ones.

verses.sloka: तासाम् एक अन्त विन्यस्ते शयानाम् शयने शुभे ।ददर्श रूप सम्पन्नाम् अपराम् स कपिः स्त्रियम् ॥५-१०-५०॥
verses.transliteration: tāsām eka anta vinyaste śayānām śayane śubhe ।dadarśa rūpa sampannām aparām sa kapiḥ striyam ॥5-10-50॥

translations.english: Hanuman saw some maidens lying on separate excellent beds, women richly endowed with beautysleeping.

verses.sloka: मुक्ता मणि समायुक्तैर् भूषणैः सुविभूषिताम् ।विभूषयन्तीम् इव च स्व श्रिया भवन उत्तमम् ॥५-१०-५१॥
verses.transliteration: muktā maṇi samāyuktair bhūṣaṇaiḥ suvibhūṣitām ।vibhūṣayantīm iva ca sva śriyā bhavana uttamam ॥5-10-51॥

translations.english: Then the vanara saw a very beautiful woman of golden complexion decked with pearls and gems and with ornaments as if illuminating the excellent mansion with her splendour She was the king's favourite and the chief queen, Mandodari.

verses.sloka: गौरीम् कनक वर्ण आभाम् इष्टाम् अन्तः पुर ईश्वरीम् ।कपिर् मन्द उदरीम् तत्र शयानाम् चारु रूपिणीम् ॥५-१०-५२॥
verses.transliteration: gaurīm kanaka varṇa ābhām iṣṭām antaḥ pura īśvarīm ।kapir manda udarīm tatra śayānām cāru rūpiṇīm ॥5-10-52॥

translations.english: Then the vanara saw a very beautiful woman of golden complexion decked with pearls and gems and with ornaments as if illuminating the excellent mansion with her splendour She was the king's favourite and the chief queen, Mandodari.

verses.sloka: स ताम् दृष्ट्वा महा बाहुर् भूषिताम् मारुत आत्मजः ।तर्कयाम् आस सीता इति रूप यौवन सम्पदा ॥५-१०-५३॥
verses.transliteration: sa tām dṛṣṭvā mahā bāhur bhūṣitām māruta ātmajaḥ ।tarkayām āsa sītā iti rūpa yauvana sampadā ॥5-10-53॥

translations.english: On seeing her embellished with ornaments, beauty and charm, the long armed son of the Windgod, the chief of the vanaras thought her to be Sita and rejoiced.

verses.sloka: हर्षेण महता युक्तो ननन्द हरि यूथपः ।आश्पोटयाम् आस चुचुम्ब पुच्चम् ।ननन्द चिक्रीड जगौ जगाम।स्तम्भान् अरोहन् निपपात भूमौ ।निदर्शयन् स्वाम् प्रक्र्तिम् कपीनाम् ॥५-१०-५४॥
verses.transliteration: harṣeṇa mahatā yukto nananda hari yūthapaḥ ।āśpoṭayām āsa cucumba puccam ।nananda cikrīḍa jagau jagāma।stambhān arohan nipapāta bhūmau ।nidarśayan svām prakrtim kapīnām ॥5-10-54॥

translations.english: He rejoiced clapping his palms, kissing his tail and jumping up, climbing up the pillars and jumping down on the ground in joy. Thus he exhibited his monkey nature. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे दशमस्सर्गः। Thus ends the tenth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
